final.intro: Keep this take and make the final version of the shot.
final.upscaleHint: SeedVR2 enlarges this take as it is: fastest, the motion does not change.
final.upscaleH3: MiniMax H3 enlarges this take with its own upscale mode: the motion does not change.
final.renderHint: Or render the shot again at {res} with the same seed: slower, the result may differ slightly.
final.guidedHint: Or render the shot again with LTX-2.5 at {res}, following this take: same motion and framing, new detail.
finalPass.title: Make the film final
finalPass.intro: Each shot starts from its Final take, which serves as the reference: its motion and framing are kept. Each finished final goes on its shot, and the draft stays in the shot's takes.
finalPass.method.label: Method
finalPass.hint.upscale: SeedVR2 enlarges each take as it is to the target resolution; a take of the base MiniMax H3 preset can use its own upscale mode. The motion does not change.
finalPass.hint.guided: LTX-2.5 renders each shot again in {res}, following its take through the Layout-To-Render IC-LoRA: same motion and framing, new detail. Experimental: slower, and the look can drift from the take.
finalPass.hint.guidedMissing: A guided render needs LTX-2.5 and the Layout-To-Render IC-LoRA: ask an administrator to install them.
finalPass.hint.render: Each shot is generated again at the largest size of its engine with the same seed. It does not follow the take: the result can differ.
finalPass.sound.upscale: Sound: the sound of each take is kept.
finalPass.sound.guided: Sound: the sound of each take is laid on the new one; a silent take stays silent.
finalPass.sound.render: Sound: made again as for the draft (reference tracks cut again, sound of the engine generated again).
finalPass.upscaler.label: Upscaler
